text: Lord Fauntleroy paused a moment to reflect. He was not very sure himself what it meant. He had taken it for granted as meaning something very creditable because Dick had been fond of using it. “I think it means that he wouldn't cheat any one,” he exclaimed; “or hit a boy who was under his size, and that he blacks people's boots very well and makes them shine as much as he can. He's a perfessional bootblack.” “And he's one of your acquaintances, is he?” said the Earl.
